report.summary: I made no code changes. The cause is that server.mjs sync() overwrites only the services upstream answers for and returns { syncedAt, updated, failed }. public/src/sync.js ignores `failed`, always shows "Last synced at …" and reloads the panel, so fresh and stale rows look identical. SYN-1 only describes the case where every service answers, so it doesn't say what a partial failure should do. Two fixes are valid: (1) all-or-nothing, where no states change, no "Last synced" is shown, and a failure message names the services that timed out; (2) a partial update where the services that answered are updated, timed-out services are marked as out of date with their last-checked time, and the status line says the sync was partial. I recommend (2), but it is a product decision.
report.question: When some services time out during Sync now, should the sync be all-or-nothing (keep all old states and show a failure naming the services that timed out), or a partial update (apply the states that arrived and visibly mark the timed-out services as not updated)? If partial, should "Last synced at HH:MM" still appear alongside the warning?
